description: What tday knows about this brand's product features, newest added first: which already have a demo video (or one being made) and which do not, their other videos and captured UI, likely routes, and each feature's id for demo_start or capture_start. Use it to find the latest feature, the features still without a demo, or a feature by name. Adds one line on the docs pages still to demo (demo_docs lists them). Needs no demo running. With the developer's own tday login the brand is the one connected to this repo; pass brandId when they work on several.

brandId.description: The brand, when the developer's own tday login works on several (default: the one connected to this repo)

repoDir.description: The repo whose git remote picks the brand (default: the current directory)

search.description: Only features whose title contains this

without.description: "demo": only features with no demo video yet

name: demo_features
title: See the brand's features and their videos
